name: Pedroso de Acim (Spain)
description: A blue hoist third charged with the crowned municipal arms of Pedroso de Acim (a cross of Alcántara and a rock on white and blue), the fly white with two red horizontal stripes.
history: Municipal flag of Pedroso de Acim; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Pedroso de Acim arms — cross of Alcántara and rock
two horizontal stripes on the white fly
